description: Do NPCs shoot back? Jump to Yrmori (0.6), call one Minmatar police patrol to the ship with the fleet trigger, load the Rifter's autocannons, then lock and fire on the patrol. The report records the shots (lock, ProjectileFired, damage bands on the target) and the patrol's response: the retaliation log line, its lock on the ship and damage to the ship.

during.note: the patrol lands out of warp

expect.note: the ship locks the patrol hull
the client is told the guns fire at it
being shot wakes the flight to fight back
the patrol locks the ship back
